animations.name: Light Kick Pro
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start and end in the exact supplied standing guard pose. Execute one solid straight horizontal side light kick: keep the supporting leg planted firmly on the ground baseline, turn the hips sideways, and thrust the kicking leg straight out to the right at hip-to-waist height, keeping the entire shoe cleanly inside the right edge of the frame. At peak extension, extend the near arm diagonally down-back behind the hip for balance while keeping the far arm bent near the torso, head turned right watching the target. Smoothly retract the leg back to the exact standing guard pose. Preserve Pippo's exact face, beard, short dark hair, charcoal cardigan, cuffed blue jeans, brown shoes, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no effects or props.
